text:
maria: quick ping — opened PR https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/23389 to fix a bad tail-latency regression when kv-cache misses spike. this needs runtime + infra + security eyes before we can canary. tagging: @sam @jonah @ashley

sam: saw the diff — looks small. can you add perf numbers from the local microbench? and list the rollback plan. we need that for dedicated clusters.

maria: added a small perf table to the PR description and a rollback script snippet: `kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/worker worker=registry/release:voldemort-fix || true` — if canary fails we revert and route to variant-v1.

jonah: i'll take runtime review by EOD. quick scan: does this change kernel selection or batching logic?

maria: it touches batcher.h and kv_cache.cpp. it avoids full-cache invalidation on partial eviction, so should be safe for kernels. no kernel ABI changes.

ashley: security quick question: does the change affect any user-visible IV or key material handling? i.e., any new env var or file permission changes?

maria: no new secrets or mounts. only changes cache eviction logic in-process. added asserts and a small extra metric `kv_miss_surge` to Graphite.

ci-bot: CI passed — unit tests (208) and bench smoke run OK. integration tests queued (will report in ~10m).

sam: also cc infra — we need to reserve a 30m canary window for dedicated-north. can we do 2024-03-12 02:00 UTC?

jonah: that slot works for me. i'll do the rollout and monitor KV hit/miss and p50/p99 for request latency. will put a dashboard link in PR after I create it.

ashley: security LGTM with one follow-up: add a short note to PR about why we think this doesn't expand attack surface, and mention metric names. then i'm good to +1.

maria: done — added the short note and metric names. thanks! :thumbsup:

sam: once jonah confirms dashboard + smoke, i can approve infra side and we can schedule the merge in the next merge window (2024-03-12 02:00 UTC).

jonah: dashboard created and linked in PR. initial canary rollout plan is in the PR description. i'll watch logs and set alert thresholds for `kv_miss_surge` and `worker_latency_p99`.

maria: amazing — thanks team. tagging this thread to keep async track. moving to merge queue once approvals are in.

ashley: noted, will bump to security queue after smoke.

ci-bot: integration tests passed (all green).

maria: merging once sam clicks approve. will do staggered deploy. :rocket:
